comparison: Same real adjacent consonant-vowel tokens, exact PCM frames and enrollment/query sources. Split: separately pooled C/V features, shared encoder, mean of normalized embeddings then L2 normalization. Joined: pool the continuous original C+V interval, same encoder and output size. Both trained from identical initialization with identical token schedule and shared branch dropout shape.
pair_selection: Counts only, train and validation only, no EER. Require at least two eligible tokens for 80% of training speakers in each of four corpora, at least one enrollment token for every validation speaker in each evaluation corpus, and presence in 5% of normal validation queries in each corpus. Rank by worst-corpus validation query coverage, then pair label, and retain at most ten. Freeze before any test pair extraction.
geometry: Existing QC-accepted single-phone intervals only; adjacent original alignment indices, identical boundary frames, each phone at least 30ms, total at most 250ms. No crop, padding, splicing, skipped phones or pause bridging. Both arms use precisely the same retained original PCM frames.
training: Fresh shared statistics MLP with 65920 parameters, AAM plus 0.5 within-pair-type SupCon. Five groups of ten speakers and two distinct tokens per speaker per update, identical across arms. Fixed final 6000 updates per selected type, no validation checkpoint selection. Same existing train-only feature normalization.
evaluation: Same original evaluation speaker and utterance splits and enrollment source WAVs. Pair-type enrollment means and query means, cosine per type, equal mean over query-available types registered for all claims. Preserve original five-vowel query eligibility and retain no-score inputs as rejection. Freeze all final models and validation FAR1% thresholds before test inference. Pair-only study, not a replacement for the previous full-phone Transformer.
limits: Previously observed test cohorts; three training seeds. Mean/std features do not explicitly encode temporal order. The contrast includes separate vs joint feature extraction and embedding aggregation, not a causal isolation of coarticulation. Pair availability may reduce coverage. No change to standard model; sequence-preserving architectures are a later experiment.
